class.name: JustAMCPMCPAppsHost
class.brief_description: Host for MCP Apps UI iframes served from the local JustAMCP HTTP server.
class.description: Detects [code]_meta.ui.resourceUri[/code] on remote tools, enforces deny-by-default CSP and permissions, and proxies App Bridge [code]tools/call[/code] messages through [JustAMCPMCPClientBridge] after user consent. The host page is served at [code]/mcp-apps/host[/code].

method.name: host_url
method.description: Returns the loopback URL for the MCP Apps host page.

method.name: list_open_apps
method.description: Returns the currently registered MCP Apps (HTML payloads omitted).

method.name: open_app
method.description: Registers an MCP App and returns the loopback host URL. The browser is opened only when the JustAMCP HTTP server is listening and the process is not headless or running unit tests.

method.name: proxy_tools_call
method.description: Forwards an App Bridge [code]tools/call[/code] through the outbound MCP client after consent.
